name: 95066 · Scotts Valley, CA
findings: ZIP 95066 (Scotts Valley) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95066 (Scotts Valley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95066 (Scotts Valley) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
